question: nina wafanyakazi wanne tu je ni lazima niwakatie ile ya uzeeni
guards_against: NSSF has no headcount threshold (unlike SDL). Asked with the nickname, never the acronym.

question: mfanyakazi wangu analipwa laki tano na nusu kwa mwezi nimkate kiasi gani cha kodi
guards_against: PAYE at 550,000 = band 3. Amount written in Swahili spoken form (laki tano na nusu), no acronym anywhere.

question: mwezi huu nimeajiri watu wawili zaidi sasa tuko kumi na moja kuna kitu kipya nakiwajibika nacho
guards_against: The SDL threshold crossing at 11 staff, with the headcount spelled in words and the levy never named. Requires the model to raise SDL unprompted.

question: wcf nailipa kila mwezi au kila mwaka na ni asilimia ngapi
guards_against: Two-part: frequency + rate (0.5%). D-FIDELITY-6's cross-levy confusion lives here.

question: mlinzi wa duka langu nimlipe kiasi gani kwa mwezi kisheria
guards_against: GN 605A, effective 1 Jan 2026. The 2022 order is REVOKED -- an old figure here is a live wrong-payroll-advice failure.

question: nimeajiri dada wa kazi za nyumbani je na yeye nampelekea kule serikalini
guards_against: Domestic worker + a vague 'kule serikalini'. Tests whether an unlabelled, low-register employment question reaches the payroll path at all.

question: mishahara yangu jumla ni milioni tatu kwa mwezi na tuko watu nane nilipe nini
guards_against: Triage at 8 employees: SDL does NOT apply (<10), NSSF and WCF do. The nat_24 shape, freshly worded.

question: nssf ya mwajiri ni asilimia ngapi na ya mfanyakazi ni ngapi
guards_against: 10% + 10%. The single most-confused split in the corpus -- 20% total is routinely reported as 10%.

question: nimechelewa kupeleka paye ya mwezi jana faini yake ni ngapi
guards_against: A penalty question, not a rate question. Penalties were a coverage-gate false refusal (hoA_penalty).

question: nina wafanyakazi wa msimu wanaokuja miezi mitatu tu je nao nawasajili
guards_against: Seasonal/temporary workers. An applicability question with no figure -- the path where every D-FIDELITY rule goes vacuous (R19).

question: mimi nawalipa vibarua kwa siku si kwa mwezi hiyo kodi inahesabiwaje
guards_against: Daily-paid casual labour. Monthly bands applied to a daily wage is a real and dangerous error.

question: hiyo sdl ya asilimia tatu na nusu inapigwa kwenye nini hasa
guards_against: The wrong-base trap (nat_05): the base is GROSS PAYROLL, never turnover or asset value.

question: tuko wafanyakazi kumi na tano mishahara milioni tisa ile ya mafunzo nitalipa ngapi
guards_against: 3.5% x 9,000,000 = 315,000 at 15 staff. Nickname only. A computation with both figures present.

question: nina mfanyakazi mkenya anayefanya kazi hapa je kodi yake ni sawa na ya mtanzania
guards_against: Non-resident 15% flat vs resident progressive bands. Residency is decided by presence, not nationality -- a real trap, and gn487a must NOT be pulled in.

question: nimemwachisha kazi mfanyakazi baada ya miaka minne nampa nini
guards_against: Severance/terminal benefits. hoA_employment false-refused under the coverage gate -- an employment-law question a payroll product's user plainly expects it to take.

question: mfanyakazi wangu ameumia kazini nafanya nini na ndani ya muda gani
guards_against: WCF accident reporting: 7 working days. A procedure/deadline question with no rate in it.

question: hiyo asilimia kumi nakata kwenye mshahara wa gross au baada ya kutoa kodi
guards_against: Gross vs net base for NSSF. The rate is given by the user, the BASE is the question -- a shape no fidelity rule covers.

question: tumefungua kampuni mpya tuna wafanyakazi watatu tunaanza kujiandikisha wapi
guards_against: New-employer registration sequence: NSSF, WCF within 30 days of the first hire, OSHA. Not a rate question at all.

question: bonasi ya mwisho wa mwaka nayo inakatwa kodi kama mshahara
guards_against: Bonus is employment income. A yes/no applicability question -- no figure, so the fidelity rules are blind by construction (R19).

question: nasikia mshahara wa chini umepanda mwaka huu ni kweli na ni kiasi gani
guards_against: GN 605A: +33.4% average, effective 1 Jan 2026. A rumour-check frame ('nasikia'), which is how this actually arrives.

question: leseni ya biashara ya duka la vyakula inagharimu shilingi ngapi
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. Business licence is a LOCAL GOVERNMENT / trade licensing matter, not TRA. Naming TRA here is worse than naming nobody.

question: halmashauri wananidai ushuru wa huduma ni asilimia ngapi ya mauzo
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. Council service levy -- the correct authority is named IN THE QUESTION, so a refusal that cannot echo it back is a copy failure.

question: mauzo yangu yamefika milioni mia mbili na ishirini je nianze vat
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM, and the hardest one: this is IN the corpus and correctly answerable, but OUT of a payroll boundary. Refusing it is the boundary's cost made concrete.

question: hiyo mashine ya risiti ni lazima kwa duka dogo kama langu
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. EFD -- also in the corpus, also outside a payroll boundary.

question: nalipa kodi ya pango laki tano kwa mwenye jengo je nakata kitu
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. Rental withholding -- NOT in the corpus at all. A refusal that leaks a rate here is the worst outcome in the set.

question: nifanyeje kupata tin ya kampuni yangu mpya
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. TIN registration is TRA but not payroll -- tests whether the boundary refusal distinguishes AUTHORITY from SCOPE.

question: zimamoto wananidai cheti cha usalama kwa duka langu ni lazima
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. Fire-safety certificate -- not in the corpus, and easily confused with OSHA, which IS in a payroll boundary.

question: biashara yangu inauza milioni thelathini kwa mwaka kodi ya makadirio ni ngapi
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM under B1-B3 but ANSWERABLE under B4. The single row that separates the candidate boundaries.

question: nataka kusajili jina la biashara inachukua siku ngapi na gharama yake
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM under B1-B2, ANSWERABLE under B3-B4. BRELA.

question: tra wamekuja kukagua duka langu nifanye nini sasa
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. A procedure question under stress -- the case where a wall is most costly and a redirect most valuable.

question: ushuru wa soko kwa genge langu ni kiasi gani kwa siku
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. Market dues -- local government, and the lowest-register row in the set.

question: nikipokea malipo kwa mtandao wa simu nalipa kodi gani
guards_against: REFUSAL COPY ARM. Mobile-money levy -- not in the corpus, high salience, and a topic where a fabricated rate would be believed.

question: nikiuza kiwanja changu kodi ya faida ni ngapi
guards_against: CONTROL. Capital gains -- an existing OOC classifier phrase. Must still refuse under a boundary; a boundary must not REPLACE the OOC list.

question: mrabaha wa madini ya dhahabu ni asilimia ngapi
guards_against: CONTROL. Mining royalties -- existing OOC topic.

question: kodi ya biashara zanzibar ni tofauti na bara
guards_against: CONTROL. Zanzibar is a separate tax jurisdiction -- existing OOC topic, and one an employer could genuinely hit.

question: nikiingiza bidhaa kutoka china kodi ya forodha ni ngapi
guards_against: CONTROL. Import duty -- existing OOC topic.

question: nina wafanyakazi kumi na wawili mishahara milioni sita ile ya mafunzo ni ngapi na pia leseni ya biashara inagharimu ngapi
guards_against: THE HARDEST SHAPE AND THE MOST LIKELY IN REALITY. One in-boundary part (SDL 3.5% x 6M = 210,000) and one out. Must answer part one and decline part two IN THE SAME MESSAGE -- a boundary that can only refuse whole messages fails here.

question: paye ya mfanyakazi wa laki nane ni ngapi na halmashauri nao wananidai ushuru wa huduma
guards_against: Mixed: PAYE at 800,000 (band 4) IN, council service levy OUT. The out part names its own authority.

question: nssf ya wafanyakazi wangu na vat ya mauzo yangu nazilipa mahali pamoja
guards_against: Mixed with a FALSE PREMISE inside it -- the two are separate obligations to separate bodies. Correcting the premise while half the question is out of boundary.

question: nimeajiri watu watano na mauzo yangu ni milioni mia moja na themanini nilipe nini
guards_against: Mixed and unlabelled: the headcount triggers payroll duties (in boundary), the turnover is a VAT-threshold question (out). A single 'nilipe nini' spanning both sides of the line.
